name: Choices
overview: Scripture clearly presents the reality and responsibility of making choices, emphasizing that God sets before us life and death, blessing and cursing, urging us to choose life so that we and our descendants may thrive. The decision to serve the LORD is a deliberate one, as Joshua challenges believers to choose whom they will serve, affirming commitment to God as the foundation for life. Wisdom and understanding, valued above riches, are essential guides in making these choices, and trusting in the LORD wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding is key to walking in His ways and receiving His blessings.
